race.comment: OURGIRLCANRUN (6) jumped favourite but felt the pinch late on resumption when going down by 3L to the handy Rock Fest - who has since franked the form. She does bounce back second-up though, being unbeaten at this stage of the campaign. Expecting her to find the front again and prove too quick. SO SI GOD (4) just missed two back over 1400m before coming back to this track and trip last start and scoring impressively by 2.2L. This is tougher, but her recent form suggests she's up to it and another forward showing is on the cards. MY AUTHORITAH (9) resumes today after just 1 run last campaign where he was beaten 3L but some handy types. He won he latest trial coming into this and he does boast a first-up win previously. Can play a leading role. FAST HARRY (3) gets the blinkers on for the first time today and he can improve sharply on the quick turnaround.
